tasks.label: boardly: dlv headless server (:2345)
tasks.detail: Start the API under delve, then use the 'attach to headless dlv' launch config
tasks.command: bash -lc 'cd server && set -a && source .env && set +a && exec "$HOME/go/bin/dlv" debug ./cmd/server --headless --listen=127.0.0.1:2345 --api-version=2 --accept-multiclient'
